title: A Taxonomy of Real Faults in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2502.08739v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the popularity of Hybrid Quantum-Classical architectures, particularly noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) architectures, comes the need for quality assurance methods tailored to their specific faults. In this study, we propose a taxonomy of faults in Hybrid Quantum-Classical architectures accompanied by a dataset of real faults in the identified categories. To achieve this, we empirically analysed open-source repositories for fixed faults. We analysed over 5000 closed issues on GitHub and pre-selected 529 of them based on rigorously defined inclusion criteria. We selected 133 faults that we labelled around symptoms and the origin of the faults. We cross-validated the classification and labels assigned to every fault between two of the authors. translated_title: 混合量子-经典架构中真实故障的分类体系
translated_abstract: 随着混合量子-经典架构（Hybrid Quantum-Classical architectures）的日益普及，特别是含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）架构的广泛应用，需要针对其特定故障量身定制的质量保证方法。在本研究中，我们提出了混合量子-经典架构中故障的分类体系，并附带一个包含已识别类别中真实故障的数据集。为实现这一目标，我们对开源代码库中已修复的故障进行了实证分析。我们分析了GitHub上超过5000个已关闭的issue，并根据严格定义的纳入标准预先筛选出529个。我们最终选取了133个故障，并围绕故障的症状和成因对其进行了标注。两位作者对每个故障的分类和标签进行了交叉验证。最终，我们构建了混合量子-经典架构中真实故障的分类体系。随后，我们通过对十一位开发者的访谈验证了该分类体系的有效性。
tldr: 本文通过实证分析GitHub上超过5000个已关闭issue，提出并验证了首个混合量子-经典（NISQ）架构中真实故障的分类体系，并发布了包含133个标注真实故障的数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and validates the first taxonomy of real faults in hybrid quantum-classical (NISQ) architectures through an empirical analysis of over 5000 closed GitHub issues, accompanied by a dataset of 133 labeled real faults.
